edits.new: Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary and the TSD P5 T3.1 table. The names `extraction_method`, `review_only` and `party_names` are attributes read inside `field_definitions` (DF-REF-224) of the document type and are not separate fields of LDM v9 or Data Classification v5. edits.old: S4 `rwb-litigation` and S2 `rwb-treatment` call the checked-fields read under their own service identity through the contract RWB-P5-E2025-CON.
edits.new: S4 `rwb-litigation` and S2 `rwb-treatment` call the checked-fields read under their own service identity through the contract RWB-P5-E2025-CON. The checked-fields read is published on `/api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/checked-fields` and returns a CheckedFieldSet of CheckedField elements (documentId, docVersion, fieldName, value, state, confidence), the smallest superset of the legacy field list. The three extraction operations are consumed from RWB-P5-E1053-CON and none is re-declared here; the extraction event stays the one declared event, with the new type codes in documentType. The S2 rwb-treatment side takes the operation, path and payload from RWB-P5-E2025-CON; party_names stays masked and is stored nowhere, and the tableVersion of the reader's answer is stamped on the treatment row in the same transaction as the facts. The model name and version behind the agent route, the provider product, the alert thresholds, the business-hours window of the intake Schedule and the alert identifiers are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1022) and ship as environment values with a placeholder until confirmed; the model route endpoint and the client credential are bound as a secret reference of the service identity.
